decisions.statement: The reading is the sum of the day's stretches.
The capacity a stretch has is the hours the stretch ran times the capacity an hour was worth.
A stretch gives capacity back or takes capacity away.
A stretch still running is worth the hours run so far.
A stretch beginning after the moment the reading is taken ran no hours.
A capacity below zero is a reading.
A capacity given as text is read as the number that text spells.
A stretch with no capacity is left out of the sum.
No stretch on the day is no reading rather than a capacity of zero.
A day whose every stretch has no capacity is no reading rather than a capacity of zero.
A day is read as holding two hundred stretches at the most.
That bound is the bound the reach taking the reading carries.
Nothing here caches a reading or decides when a reading is taken.
Nothing here turns a capacity into a color.

definition: how much stress capacity Alan has in hand
